name: Abandentment
overview: The Scriptures affirm God's unwavering presence and faithfulness, assuring believers that He will neither fail nor forsake them, even when earthly relationships abandon them. Passages like Deuteronomy 31:6 and Hebrews 13:5 emphasize God's promise to never leave His people, while Isaiah 41:10 and Joshua 1:9 encourage strength and courage rooted in His sustaining power. This divine assurance culminates in the gospel truth of John 3:16, revealing God's ultimate act of love through Christ, securing eternal life for those who believe.
